title: Absolute Galois group
statement: For a field $K$ with a chosen algebraic closure $\overline K$ in the sense of [def-weil-algebraic-closure], the absolute Galois group $\Gal(\overline K/K)$ is the group of field automorphisms of $\overline K$ fixing $K$ pointwise.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: the group $\overline K\simeq_{K}\overline K$ of K-algebra automorphisms of the chosen closure (instance AlgEquiv.aut, Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Equiv.lean:637, with A_1 = \overline K, R = K); a K-algebra automorphism is exactly a field automorphism fixing \iota(K) pointwise. For Mathlib's own closure AlgebraicClosure K this group is Field.absoluteGaloisGroup (Mathlib/FieldTheory/AbsoluteGaloisGroup.lean:43), which is tied to that particular closure and is therefore not used as the match for an arbitrary chosen closure.
